# Playthrough Strategy

Pre-made strategy for the agent, plus the agent's own notes added as it plays. Every chapter has
its own section below with a **Recruits** table (pre-filled by the human) and an **Agent notes**
area (filled in by the agent). Broad, cross-chapter lessons go under **Broad strategy notes**.

## General Strategy

- Always select "yes" to accept side missions when offered the choice to do so.

## Recruiting Units

In each chapter, there are often units that appear as green units (uncontrollable allies) or red units (enemies). These units can often be recruited by executing the Talk action with a specific player-controlled unit, but there are some more complex conditions that have to be fulfilled in order to recruit some characters. For each chapter, you have been provided a list of the recruitable units that appear and the conditions that need to be fulfilled in order to recruit the character. You should try to recruit units if possible, but it is not a strict requirement.

The chapter sections below cover Lyn mode and Hector mode. Eliwood mode is not covered. Recruits are the same on normal and hard difficulty throughout the entire game, so use the list for your mode regardless of difficulty.

## Promoting Units

Fire Emblem has a mechanic known as promotion, where a unit advances to a stronger class. A unit must be at least level 10 to be promoted, although it can go as high as level 20 before being promoted. It is up to you to decide when it is appropriate to promote a unit.

In virtually all cases, a unit is promoted by using a specific consumable item that matches its class. For example, a knight can use a knight crest to be promoted to a general.

Cross-chapter lessons the agent adds as it plays. Append below.

content.text: Holding the two stairways with armored units. Next: the right stair.
Pulling wounded Bartre back from the right stair.
Marcus one-shots it (20 dmg vs 22? close) and takes 0. Attacking.
Oswin was at 8 HP from shamans; pulling him back and checking for a Vulnerary.
Weighing how to plug the left opening against shamans; cancelling an accidental selection first.
Repositioning: Eliwood aside, then Lowen rescues Oswin, Marcus plugs the left gap.
Lowen picked up Oswin; checking the game state before moving Marcus.
Marcus takes only 3 per Flux — ideal left-gap holder. Attacking.
Trying the archer on the 4-HP myrmidon first, then Dorcas plugs the right stair.
Both gaps plugged (Marcus left, Dorcas right). Ending turn 3.
Turn 4: everyone alive (Marcus 27, Dorcas 23). Having Rebecca snipe the weakened cavalier below Dorcas.
Rebecca got the kill. Now Marcus attacks the enemy below him.
Moved Eliwood back next to Merlinus, out of shaman range. Ending turn 4.
Lancereaver merc at 3 HP, 97% hit — attacking.
Turn 6, all units alive. Checking blocker HP.
No vulneraries in supply. Backing out; will rotate blockers if they drop low.
Dorcas down to 14 — rotating her out and putting Hector on the right stair (checking forecast first).
Hector takes only 2 per hit — solid. Attacking.
Marcus at 17 — still the best left holder (shamans do 3 to him). Attacking the enemy below.
Enemy phase still running; Marcus at 10 HP. Waiting it out.
Turn 8 — enemy count is way down, but Marcus is at 5 HP. Surveying remaining enemies before reshuffling.
Only ~7 enemies remain. Plan: pull blockers back one tile so only 2 enemies can reach each, and chip shamans with ranged units. Checking Rebecca's forecast on a shaman.
Rebecca can't hurt shamans and would eat an 11-damage counter — cancelling.
**Hector is at 2/26 HP** — top priority is getting him completely out of reach. Checking the mercenary's stats to pick the right-side blocker.
Merc is weak (6 dmg to Eliwood, no double). Plan: Eliwood seals right at the top of the stair, Lowen (still carrying Oswin) seals left, Hector and Marcus hide in the bow.
Hector hidden at the bow; Eliwood sealing the right stair. Now Marcus out, Lowen in on the left.
Marcus was at 2 HP — now hidden. Moving Lowen to seal the left at the top of the passage.
Repositioning weaker units out of shaman reach.
Game over on the turn-8 enemy phase — a lord died, but I didn't see which one or what killed him (possibly reinforcements I hadn't spotted). Recording what I learned, then restarting.

content.text: Attempt 2 plan: Marcus seals left and Oswin seals right, each one tile back from the stair top so only 2 enemies can reach them. Lords stay in the bow, and row 3 stays empty.
Nothing reached us yet; Oswin full. Ending turn 2.
Turn 3: enemies now on both passage tiles. Checking blocker HP.
Both blockers scored kills (Marcus 32 HP, Oswin 23). Continuing to end turn 3.
Turn 4. Same routine: check blockers, attack the enemies on the passage tiles.
Oswin is at 16 and already acted. Checking whether Lowen can kill the shaman on the right stair to protect him.
Poor odds for Lowen (needs both hits, eats 11). Cancelling; leaving Oswin to hold.
**Oswin is at 5 HP** — pulling him out and rotating in a fresh blocker.
Dorcas killed the merc and now holds the right. Checking Marcus on the left.
Archer can't counter, Marcus kills (21×2 vs 20). Attacking.
Dorcas down to 13. Rotating Bartre into the right slot.
A Dorcas–Bartre support is available; taking it.
Bartre in on the right. New tactic: leave weak physical enemies sitting on the passage tiles so shamans can't take those spots.
Bartre fell on the right during the enemy phase (30 HP gone in one phase). I can't rewind outside a chapter loss, so I'm continuing.
Oswin (5 HP) also fell — enemies poured through after Bartre died. Continuing the enemy phase.
Turn 7: two shamans broke onto the deck through the right side. Bartre and Oswin are dead. Priority: kill those two and re-seal the right. Checking forecasts.
Dorcas doubles for 17s against a 19-HP shaman and can survive the counter at 1 HP. Attacking.
Dorcas whiffed both. Trying Lowen next.
Hector has a 90% kill on a 2-HP shaman. Attacking.
One shaman down. The other sits on the right chokepoint tile. Plan: Eliwood kills it from the side, then Rebecca fills the chokepoint. Checking Eliwood's reach.
Eliwood: 13×2 at 100% vs 19 HP — guaranteed kill. Attacking.
Shaman dead. Rebecca now plugs the right chokepoint tile.
Rebecca fell holding the right plug. Continuing.
Hector fell at the end of the turn-8 enemy phase, so attempt 2 is lost too. Bartre, Oswin and Rebecca had already died, but all of them come back on restart. Recording what I learned and restarting.

content.text: A Preparations screen — I skipped past it on the earlier attempts. Checking the full roster for better units (a healer or a mage would change everything).
Serra (healer), Lyn, Matthew and Sain are available but not deployed. Scrolling for more.

content.thinking: Swapping Rebecca and Bartre for Serra and Erk, since Rebecca does no damage to shamans and Erk resists Flux well.

content.text: Serra is in, carrying two Heal staves and two Vulneraries. Adding Erk.
Lineup set: Eliwood, Hector, Marcus, Lowen, Oswin, Dorcas, Serra, Erk. Now giving Vulneraries from Serra to the blockers.
Serra shows an empty inventory in Trade, which contradicts what the pick screen showed. Checking her items directly.
The List shows all army items by owner. Jumping to staves.
Heal staves are in the convoy. Taking both for Serra.
Useful items in stock, including a Knight Crest (Oswin could promote) and a Hero Crest. Scrolling for Vulneraries.
Serra now has both Heal staves. Next: Oswin, to check his level for the Knight Crest and give him a Vulnerary.
Oswin is level 11, so he can promote. Giving him the Knight Crest and a Vulnerary.
Opened a trade with Matthew, who holds the crest. Moving it to Oswin.
Oswin has the Knight Crest. Using it now.
Oswin is now a General (34 HP, Def 16, Res 7). Next, Vulneraries for Marcus and Dorcas.
Oswin has a Vulnerary. That's enough prep; starting the battle.
Battle started (Merlinus deployed for convoy access). Setting the same formation: Marcus left, Oswin right, lords and Serra safe behind.
Hector is hidden at the bow. Moving Eliwood up beside him.
Turn 2. Myrmidons on the right stair can't scratch General Oswin, so he can step down a tile and start killing them.
Turn 3. Checking Oswin on the right passage.
Oswin untouched at 30/34. Attacking the myrmidon below.
Killed. Now Marcus steps down to the left passage to attack the shaman below, since Flux only does 3 to him.
Both blockers scored kills: Marcus 32/34, Oswin 30/34. Ending turn 3.
Marcus killed his target. Now Oswin.
Oswin killed his target (27/34). Ending turn 5.
Marcus 18/34. Plan: Marcus attacks, then Serra steps directly behind him to heal (only one tile can reach her there).
